dataset_info.title: Enhanced Behavioral Intention Dataset - Bank Security Practices
dataset_info.description: Comprehensive dataset for studying behavioral intentions regarding bank security practices using Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB) and Protection Motivation Theory (PMT) with enhanced statistical properties
enhancements: Additional measurement items for each construct

demographic_variables.gender: Gender identity (Male, Female, Other, Prefer not to say)
demographic_variables.previous_fraud_experience: Binary indicator of previous fraud experience (0=No, 1=Yes)

attitude.description: Overall evaluation of following bank security steps

items.ATT1: Following bank security steps is beneficial/harmful
items.ATT2: Following bank security steps is wise/foolish
items.ATT3: Following bank security steps is important/unimportant
items.ATT4: Following bank security steps is valuable/worthless
items.ATT5: Following bank security steps is pleasant/unpleasant

subjective_norm.description: Perceived social pressure to follow security steps

items.SN1: Most people who are important to me think I should follow these steps
items.SN2: My family expects me to be diligent with my bank security
items.SN3: My friends would approve of me following these steps
items.SN4: My colleagues think it's important to follow security steps

perceived_behavioral_control.description: Perceived ease and control over following security steps

items.PBC1: For me, following all the security steps would be easy/difficult
items.PBC2: I have the resources, time, and knowledge to follow them
items.PBC3: Whether I follow them is entirely up to me
items.PBC4: I am confident I can follow these security steps
items.PBC5: I have the necessary skills to follow these steps

intention.description: Behavioral intention to follow security steps

items.INT1: I intend to follow all recommended security steps in the next 3 months
items.INT2: I plan to make an effort to be more diligent
items.INT3: I will try my best to follow these security steps
items.INT4: I am committed to following these security steps

threat_appraisal.description: Perception of threat severity and personal vulnerability

items.Perceived_Severity: The financial loss from fraud would be severe for me
items.Perceived_Vulnerability: I am at high risk of experiencing bank fraud
items.Threat_Probability: It is likely that I will experience bank fraud
items.Threat_Consequences: The consequences of bank fraud would be serious for me

coping_appraisal.description: Belief in personal ability and solution effectiveness

items.Self_Efficacy: I am confident I can perform the security steps correctly
items.Response_Efficacy: I believe these security steps are effective in protecting me
items.Response_Cost: Following these security steps is worth the effort
items.Coping_Confidence: I am confident in my ability to protect myself from fraud

past_behavior.description: Self-reported frequency and consistency of following security steps

items.Past_Behavior: In the past 3 months, how often have you followed recommended security steps?
items.Behavior_Frequency: How frequently do you practice security measures?
items.Behavior_Consistency: How consistently do you follow security recommendations?

statistical_properties.correlations: Enhanced realistic correlations based on TPB and PMT theory
statistical_properties.reliability: Internal consistency designed to be >0.8 for all scales
statistical_properties.normality: Approximately normal distributions with realistic skewness
